title: 第2004章 一斧之威第2003章 追踪收获满满
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: “伽罗星主，前方波动频频，极有可能有情况，我们再提一提速度。”
伽罗听到这话，脸色苍白。
他已经很努力的在跟着了。
只叹，只差半步星河境与真正的星河境，差距实在太大。
“好！柯柏大人看着办。”
话音一落。
不得已，伽罗星只好召唤出机甲形态。
见到这一幕。
柯柏微瞥一眼，内心鄙视至极。
哼！
不伦不类的东西。
他嘴角有着明显的嫌弃与不屑。
嗖！
不再发一言，径直掠去。
伽罗星主捕捉到对方表情，他内心生起愤怒。
这个老鬼，装个屁啊装。
要不是现云域主大力培养你，就你这天赋比本星主还远不如，终有一天，让你尝到本星主的厉害。
哼！
伽罗星主不爽的追上去。
轰轰轰！
一连串的轰鸣声在炸响。
这一次。
拥有强者的领悟引导，林羽再也没有出现力不从心的表现。
令他无比惊喜的是，阎释山的领悟与他所窃取的属性相近。
一者血之大道感悟，一者是水之大道的力量。
本来就悟性超群的林羽，经历过生命层次蜕变，连悟性与慧觉都全方位提升。
没有用上多长时间。
他便能够逐渐的上手，靠着阎释山的经验与心得，林羽逐渐对雪天后的力量开始熟悉使用。
眼下。
便是如此。
他将水之大道通过血之大道的方式运作，两者竟然毫无障碍感，变幻之间通畅无比。
做到这一切。
林羽仰天长笑。
“哈哈！此禁法果然能成，这样子一来，那本尊未来就再无惧小人。”
接下来。
只要找齐对应属性，本尊若能一一窃取他们力量，那就算本身境界不达，又有什么关系？
单靠禁忌法的这份外力，就足以让本尊傲视群雄，看来本尊当初还真是做对了。
并没有第一时间利用星核提高修为，反而用到修炼禁忌法，如今，一切都无比顺畅。
若是一开始贪图境界，令自己率先一步蜕变成先天生灵，生命层次大幅度提升。

"Lord Jia Luo, there are frequent fluctuations ahead, and there is a high possibility of something happening. Let's talk about speed again."
Jialuo turned pale when he heard this.
He was already following very hard.
I just sigh, there is only half a step between the Galaxy Realm and the real Galaxy Realm, the gap is really too big.
"Okay! Lord Copper will take care of it."
The words fell.
As a last resort, Garo Star had no choice but to summon his mecha form.
Saw this scene.

snort!
Nondescript stuff.
There was obvious disgust and disdain on the corner of his mouth.
Whoosh!
Without saying a word, he just walked away.
Star Lord Jialuo caught the other person's expression, and anger arose in his heart.
This old ghost is just pretending.
If Master Xian Yun hadn't vigorously cultivated you, your talent would be far inferior to that of this Star Master. One day, you would be able to taste the power of this Star Master.
snort!
Star Lord Jialuo chased after him in displeasure.
Whoosh...
Boom boom boom!
A series of roaring sounds were heard.
This time.
With the understanding and guidance of a strong man, Lin Yu never showed signs of being unable to do what he wanted.
To his great surprise, Yan Shishan's understanding was similar to the attributes he stole.
One is the enlightenment of the avenue of blood, and the other is the power of the avenue of water.
Lin Yu, who was originally very intelligent, experienced a transformation in life levels, and even his understanding and wisdom were improved in all aspects.
It didn't take long.
He was able to gradually get started. Relying on Yan Shishan's experience and insights, Lin Yu gradually became familiar with using the power of Snow Queen.
at the moment.
That's it.
He operated the avenue of water through the avenue of blood. There was no obstacle between the two, and the changes were extremely smooth.
Do it all.
Lin Yu looked up to the sky and smiled.
"Haha! This forbidden method can indeed be accomplished. In this way, I will no longer be afraid of villains in the future."
Next.
As long as the corresponding attributes are found, if I can steal their power one by one, what does it matter even if my own realm is not reached?
The external force of the taboo law alone is enough to make me stand out from the rest. It seems that I really did the right thing in the first place.
Instead of immediately using the star core to improve his cultivation, he used the forbidden method to practice. Now, everything is going smoothly.
If you covet the realm at the beginning, you can take the lead in transforming into an innate being, and your life level will be greatly improved.
